scope.note: Exact animation acceptance and ordinary-play readiness are independent. This inventory is source-audited against the pinned tree; it does not promote move coverage.

blockers.B_DISPATCH: The live presentation command does not preserve a typed Scene-ON request and can omit no-hit MOVE_ANIMATION events.
blockers.B_LIFECYCLE: There is no ordinary-battle start/advance/finish/cleanup/queue-resume handshake; local reducer termination is not a host completion signal.
blockers.B_HOST: No production assembler currently supplies SceneOnMovePresentationState battlers, geometry, field chrome, art, and per-move inputs.
blockers.B_IDENTITY: battleScene.ts throws outside the accepted staged species pair; current battler art/HUD identity must be generalized without weakening exact acceptance.
blockers.B_BUFFER: The typed config needs allocator/GPU/OAM/palette/task or animation-profile state that fixtures/verifiers currently supply; production has no persistent provider.
blockers.B_OUTCOME: The typed config needs controller-resolved HP/status/stat/result/timing data that the live presentation command currently discards.
blockers.B_VARIANT: The move needs a charge/strike, multi-hit, branch, or turn selector preserved from live resolution.
blockers.B_RANDOM: Presentation-only random/personality words are explicit config input but are not owned/provided by the ordinary live path.
blockers.B_DERIVED: Additional geometry, offsets, slots, dimensions, or immutable presentation values must be derived by a production adapter.

hostClasses.H_BASIC: Only common battler identity/geometry and field chrome beyond the move discriminator.
hostClasses.H_DERIVED: Extra geometry/offset/slot/dimension values derivable from live battlers or a presentation allocator.
hostClasses.H_RANDOM: Presentation random words or personality-derived visual input.
hostClasses.H_BUFFER: Live allocator, OAM, affine, palette, background, audio, task, or composed animation profile.

lifecycle.L1: Reducer/module exposes first-inactive, cleanup, or inactive state locally.
lifecycle.L2: Reducer/module exposes an active/complete/terminal concept locally.
lifecycle.L3: Renderer relies on a fixed source-age envelope; no explicit local terminal symbol was found in its move modules.
lifecycle.host: All 267 lack a production completion signal consumed by the live battle queue.

availableLiveSources: The rules MOVE_ANIMATION event already carries move identity, turn, power, damage, friendship, and multi-hit data.
The live battle state owns current battlers, species, HP/status, and logical outcomes.
Neither source currently constructs SceneOnMovePresentationState or owns Scene-ON graphics buffers/lifecycle.

reusableAdapterBatches.action: Add the typed live request/completion owner: preserve every MOVE_ANIMATION including no-hit moves, clock age, finish/cleanup, and resume the real queue.
Build the common battler/field adapter for current species, both orientations, geometry, HUD, art, palettes, and healthbox values.
Replace fixture-pair renderer guards and embedded carrier/target art with the common live battler-art/HUD provider; retain each move's exact fixture tests.
Centralize derived centers, offsets, dimensions, slots, and allocator identities from live battler geometry.
Translate controller events into immutable outcome/timing profiles without letting animation own HP, status, RNG, or turn order.
Preserve two-turn, charge/strike, branch, and multi-hit body selectors in the live request.
Introduce a persistent presentation-only allocator/GPU/OAM/palette/task provider; never feed verifier capture rows into production.
Give the presentation owner a deterministic visual-RNG/personality input stream separate from gameplay RNG.

damaging.reason: Its accepted renderer is identity-generic, reads arbitrary current battler art, and its config needs only the common battlers and field profile; it has no fixture-pair, buffer, controller-outcome, variant, or visual-randomness input.

statusNoHit.reason: Its accepted renderer is identity-generic, reads arbitrary current battler art, and its config needs only the common battlers and field profile. It directly exercises the live path's current no-hit omission.

alternateMinimalDamaging.reason: It is bilateral and identity-generic with the strongest recent actual-core proof, but it is not the cheapest first adapter because ExtrasensoryLiveInputs require persistent graphics/task state.
